# UC-LEARN12 — PingFederate DaVinci Integration Kit

**Track:** learn  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

Teams want their PingFederate authentication policy to run a DaVinci flow while keeping PingFederate in control of the sign-in session.

## PingOne Solution

PingFederate invokes the installed PingOne DaVinci IdP Adapter from its authentication policy. The user must sign in through PingFederate; a PingOne application login does not run this adapter.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/pingfederate-davinci-kit","label":"Open PingFederate DaVinci Integration Kit"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `GUIDED_LEARNING`

## What to Say

> PingFederate runs the installed DaVinci Integration Kit in its authentication policy. A dedicated PF sign-in proves this run; PingOne login alone does not.
